Who We Are

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, highly organized, and client-centric Account Supervisor to manage day-to-day operations across our key integrated client accounts operating in dynamic retail environments.

In this role, you will serve as the primary operational anchor and day-to-day liaison for clients, ensuring complex 360-degree campaigns are delivered flawlessly, on strategy, on schedule, and on budget. While this position has no direct reports, you will act as a pivotal project lead—collaborating closely with cross-functional agency teams (Strategy, Creative, Media, Production, and Analytics) to drive campaign momentum, solve operational challenges, and foster strong client relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship & Day-to-Day Leadership

• Serve as the main day-to-day contact for client brand marketing teams, maintaining clear communication and high levels of client trust.

• Manage client expectations on timelines, deliverables, scope, and budget, ensuring proactive status reporting and clear meeting agendas/recap documentation.

• Understand the client’s business goals, retail environment, promotional calendar, and brand guidelines to ensure agency output aligns with commercial objectives.

Integrated Campaign Execution & Project Orchestration

• Oversee the end-to-end execution of integrated campaigns across multiple channels (digital, TV/video, print, OOH, social, CRM, e-commerce, and point-of-sale/retail activations).

• Partner with strategy and creative leads to steward work from creative brief approval through final production and campaign launch.

• Monitor project workflows, risk factors, and approval stages, ensuring all internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams meet key milestones.

• Manage asset delivery schedules, retail store/dealer collateral distribution lists, and digital channel specs.

Account Operations & Financial Management

• Manage account finances, including project scoping, fee tracking, production estimates, client approvals, and monthly billing reconciliations.

• Partner with production and finance teams to ensure projects remain profitable and within approved budget parameters.

• Track project scope changes proactively, issuing change orders or scope adjustments as needed.

Performance Tracking & Industry Knowledge

• Collaborate with media and analytics teams to monitor campaign performance, gather insights, and deliver post-campaign reporting to clients.

• Maintain a deep curiosity about marketing trends, consumer behaviours, and competitive activity in the client's industry and competitive activity in the client’s industry.

Qualifications & Experience

• Experience: 4–6 years of account management experience within an advertising, marketing, or digital agency environment.

• Integrated Expertise: Proven track record of executing multi-channel, 360-degree integrated campaigns (digital, social, video, CRM, and retail/POS collateral).

• Financial Acumen: Comfort managing project budgets, estimates, vendor costs, and billing processes.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to lead client meetings confidently.

• Organization: Exceptional project management and multi-tasking abilities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Competencies

• Self-Starter & Autonomous: Able to drive initiatives forward independently, anticipate client needs, and solve problems proactively without requiring direct reports to delegate to.

• Collaboration: Natural ability to build strong working relationships across creative, strategic, media, and production departments.

• Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to proofing, campaign specs, timing plans, and financial tracking.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

McKesson is seeking a Sr. Associate, IAM Engineer - Identity Governance to support the security and governance of user access across enterprise systems and applications. This role will help implement and maintain identity governance processes that ensure the right individuals have the right access at the right time while supporting McKesson's security, compliance, and Zero Trust objectives.

Working closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and business teams, you will assist with access governance activities, troubleshoot access-related issues, support automation efforts, and help improve identity security processes. This role is ideal for a cybersecurity professional with strong technical fundamentals, analytical thinking, and a desire to develop deep expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Identity Governance (IGA).

What You’ll Do

• Support the administration and operation of Identity Governance and Access Management solutions.
• Assist with user access provisioning, deprovisioning, role changes, and access reviews.
• Investigate and resolve access-related issues, workflow failures, and data discrepancies.
• Support access certification campaigns and governance activities by validating data and tracking remediation efforts.
• Participate in onboarding applications to identity governance platforms and documenting access requirements.
• Analyze identity and access data to identify risks, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement.
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and operational support materials.
• Assist with audit and compliance activities by preparing evidence and supporting control validation efforts.
• Use scripting, reporting, or automation tools to improve operational efficiency and data quality.
• Collaborate with technical and business teams to resolve issues and implement process improvements.
• Participate in cybersecurity and identity-related projects, testing activities, and platform enhancements.
• Continuously learn and develop expertise in identity security technologies and best practices.

Basic Requirements

• 2+ years of relevant professional experience in identity and access management, identity governance, cybersecurity, IT operations, application support, or a related technology role.
• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles including authentication, authorization, least privilege, access controls, and risk management.
• Experience troubleshooting technical issues and analyzing system behavior, logs, reports, or operational data.
• Ability to follow documented processes, identify root causes, and execute solutions within established procedures.
• Familiarity with enterprise technology environments including operating systems, directories, cloud platforms, applications, or security tools.
• Basic experience with scripting, automation, reporting, or data analysis using tools such as PowerShell, Python, SQL, Excel, or similar technologies.
• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills/Experience

• Exposure to Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Identity Governance (IGA) concepts.
• Experience testing Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions, including access requests, provisioning/deprovisioning, and user lifecycle (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) processes.
• Proficient in functional, regression, integration, and API testing with strong defect management and root cause analysis skills.
• Experience supporting compliance and audit requirements through User Access Reviews (UARs), RBAC testing, test evidence creation, and control validation.
• Working knowledge of SailPoint, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Okta, with experience validating identity integrations and access controls
• Experience working with technical data, reports, dashboards, logs, or automation tools.
• Understanding of Zero Trust, least privilege, segregation of duties, or related security concepts.
• Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Security certifications, AWS, Azure, or equivalent certifications.
• Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and security domains.
